riddles.name: Everyday Mystery1
riddles.taskDescription: I follow you everywhere, but disappear when you turn off the light. What am I?
riddles.hint: Think of a dark shape that follows you in sunlight.

riddles.name: Missing Letter
riddles.taskDescription: What letter comes next in the sequence: A, C, E, G, ?
riddles.hint: The letters are skipping one letter in the alphabet each time.

riddles.name: Tricky Pattern
riddles.taskDescription: What comes next in this sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
riddles.hint: Each number is doubled to get the next number.

riddles.name: The Endless Word
riddles.taskDescription: What word is spelled incorrectly in every dictionary?
riddles.hint: Look at the word's spelling itself rather than the dictionaries' definitions.

riddles.name: Mystery of Time
riddles.taskDescription: What has hands but cannot clap?
riddles.hint: It is an object that measures and shows the time.
